{"id":22,"answer":"Here is everything stored about you personally, grouped by area. All of it comes from your saved notes — nothing here is inferred from general knowledge, and no live web lookup was done.

LIFE ADMIN & ERRANDS
- Grocery list: 2kg basmati rice, 6 eggs, paneer, tomatoes, coriander, and dish soap (entry 9).
- Domain renewal: deepnotes.dev must be renewed before 12 October; payment goes on your HDFC card (entry 7).

FINANCE
- You have a monthly SIP of 5,000 into an index fund, executed on the 3rd (entry 31).
- Your emergency fund target is 6 months of expenses (entry 31).
- Payment card on file for at least one recurring cost is HDFC (entry 7).

HEALTH & PERSONAL WELLBEING
- Dentist appointment moved to next Tuesday at 4pm; you need to bring the insurance card (entry 22).
- You noted sleeping badly — about 4 hours — and feeling foggy, with a plan to stop caffeine after 4pm (entry 16).

TRAVEL
- Train to Pune on the 5th, departing 6:40am from platform 4 (entry 25).
- You still need to book a return for the evening of the 7th (entry 25).

FOOD & RECIPES
- Dal tadka recipe: boil toor dal with turmeric, temper cumin, garlic, dried red chilli and curry leaves in ghee, finish with lemon (entry 14).

READING
- You are reading / have read 'Make It Stick'. Your takeaway: retrieval practice beats re-reading — testing yourself is the learning, not the measurement (entry 32).

WRITING DRAFTS (borderline — these are product-related rather than personal life facts, included only because they are your own drafts)
- A draft tweet: 'Your notes app should not just store notes, it should argue with you about them', with a softer alternative 'it should form opinions about them' (entry 20).
- A draft LinkedIn post about building a local-first notes app that organizes itself in the background, where notes stay untouched and an interpretation layer evolves; you noted it needs a stronger first-line hook and possibly a privacy angle (entry 6).

WHAT IS NOT STORED
Your notes do not contain your name, age, location, family or relationship details, job title, income figures, or any other identifying personal profile data. Several of your notes are study/technical material (Java generics type erasure, SQLite FTS5/BM25) and are excluded here since they are not personal information.
